name: Perplexity API
description: Perplexity API — web search and search-grounded answers. POST /search runs a web search and returns ranked results with page contents. The Sonar chat endpoints (POST /chat/completions, plus POST/GET /v1/async/sonar for long-running research) return cited answers. The Agent API (POST /v1/agent) runs multi-step research with tools, and /v1/embeddings covers text embeddings. Auth is handled automatically via the PERPLEXITY_API_KEY environment variable as a Bearer token.

testConnection.description: Lists async Sonar requests — an authenticated read-only call that consumes no credits
